verses.text: fa-innahu kaman hadar yawma hunaynin wa sabar
wa yawma badrin wa nasar khayral waral mufah-himi
faman yuhazzim mawlidaa nabiyyinaa baabil hudaa
falaa yuhaasabu ghadaa hindal hisaabil mufhimi
fakullu man qad hadaraa mawlidaa afdalil waraa
muhazziman mubash-shiraa bisukkarin aw lahami
fa-innahu qad zafiraa bimaa yudiimul busharaa
walaa yulaaqii dararaa yawmaj timaahil umami
faman tahaaman hayya-aa liman lahu qad qara-aa
mubajjilan fakhaba-aa khayraati ahlil himami
wa man halaa shay-in qaraa mawlidaa sayyidil waraa
tabarrukan fasayaraa numuwwahu bil fadghimi
wa in halaa maa-in qurii mawlidu khayril bashari
fash shurbu bil mutahhari yakuffu kaydal murghami
yunawwirul qalbash sharaab min zaalikal maa bil mujaab
wal qalba yuhyii duuna haab wa han shaqaa-in yahtami
ihyaa-u mawlidil bashiir yahmil hiyaala wad duyuur
fiihi shifaa-un lis suduur likulli haadin yantamii
sallaa halaa khayril bashar baaqin yudiimu lil bushar
bil aali was sahbid durar maha salaamin yahtamii
yaa mulhiman qad wa faqaa salli halaa man khuliqaa
wal khalqa faaqa khuluqaa kal khalqi waltusallimi
qad kaana zaa tawassuti fil qaddi jaalis sututii
wa lam yakun bil mufrati wa lam yakun bi-aadami
wa lam yakun mutahhamaa wa lam yakun mukalsamaa
bal faaqa kulla man samaa min muntamin li-aadami
kaana yatuulu kulla man maashaahu fii kulli zaman
wa kaana waasihal hatan yadhaku bit tabassumi
wahwa jaliilun qulabu bayaaduhu musharrabu
bihumratin wa ahdabu wa anjalun zuu rasami
yaftarru fii asnab tisaam kal barqi aw habbil ghamaam
wa dahtakuhu yajluz zalaam kasurujin fii zulami
wa wajah-hu mudawwaru wahwa khamiisun azharu
wahwa bahiyyun asmaru murattilut takallumi
ka-anna maa-az zahabi fii khaddihil muhazzabi
wa kaana sabtal qasabi hirniihu zuu shamami
kaamilu uznin adhaju wa ashnabun mufalaju
wa ashkalun mubtahiju wal wajhu maahil ghumami
wahuwa akmalul waraa khalqan wa khulqan zaharaa
wal mislu qattu lam yuraa wa lan yuraa fish shiyami
ahmadunaa rahmatunaa haamidunaa nihmatunaa
mahmuudunaa farhatunaa wal juudu muzrid diyami
innii ukhaatibul jamiil musalliyan halar rasuul
musalliman halal wasuul bihizbihi fii kalimi
salli halal muddasiri khayril waral mubash-shiri
maahil firal mutahhari wa aalihi wa sallimi
salli halal muzzammili jaalid dujal mu-ammali
haamin nadal lil murmili wa sahbihi wa sallimi
salli halaa habdil ilaah habiibihi zikril ilaah
safiyyihi sayfil ilaah wa aalihi wa sallimi
salli halaa hizbil ilaah nihmatihi baabil ilaah
siraatihi hudal ilaah wa sahbihi wa sallimi
salli halaa sayyidinaa waliyyinaa qud wa tinaa
habiibinaa shafiihinaa wa aalihi wa sallimi
salli halal mu-addabi zil hurmatil mu-addibi
khayri rasuulin wa nabii wa sahbihi wa sallimi
salli halaa baabin nahiim zaakas siraatul mustaqiim
muhammadin khayril aniim wa aalihi wa sallimi
salli halaa hizzil harab wa zaakal kaashiful kurab
wa zaaka raafihur rutab wa sahbihi wa sallimi
salli halal maahil wakiil wal mutawakkiilil kafiil
qaa-idinaa ilas sabiil wa aalihi wa sallimi
salli halaa bahril buhuur laysil hidaa shafis suduur
naafish shaqaa badril buduur wa sahbihi wa sallimi
huwal lazii qaadan nadaa liman yajii lil ijtadaa
wa man nahaahu bihtadaa laaqar radaa bil wakami
huwal lazii taddat yadii bihi lirabbil af-yadi
wa jaada lii bil jayyidi min ghayri haati wa kami
lahu minal khawaariqi maa lam yaji lisaabiqi
walaa yafii lilaahiqi fadlan minal muqaddimi
minhaa salaamul hajari halayhi mash-yush shajari
lahun shiqaaqul qamari bizil baqaa wal qidami
kaana yuziluhul ghamam yaraa wa raa-a wa amaam
wa haynuhu kaanat tanaam wa qalbuhu lam yanami
minhaa tajannabuz zubaab han jismihi mahas siyaab
kazaaka tas-hilus sihaab bil laahi muulil maghnami
minhaa tawassulut tuyuur bihi lahush takaa bahiir
wan fajaral maa-un namiir min yadi zit takarrumi
sumiha tasbiihut tahaam fii kaffi afdalil anaam
khitaabu zab-yin bikalaam muhjizatul muhtarami
kalaamu dabbin qad ataa fiihaa binassin sabataa
haniimu jizhin qad ataa fii muhjizaatil mukrami
kaana yazuuru manzilah ridwaanu kay yubajjilah
minhaa tuyuurun mursalah halaa zawit tahazzumi
nahaa ilal baytil haraam likay yasiira zan hidan
mustadrajun minal anaam lil jahli bil muhazzami
wal laahu jalla fahalaa bijayshihi maa fahalaa
bijaahihi wa jahalaa kaydahumu fil yahimi
fal kullu min zawil batar maata bi-aswa-i hajar
jahalahum rabbul bashar kaluqamin linahimi
wa min khawaariqa badaa maa haaza ghaarul muqtadaa
sallaa halayhi  man hadaa bihi zawit tafahhumi
bihankabuuti nasajat maha hamaamin asbatat
hawman bihi qad satarat zaa tayhimaa kazulami
wal kaafiruuna qad ataw wa asaral maahii qafaw
wa minhu shay-an lam yaraw wa rajahuu bil alami
wa huwa zuu tasatturi mahal hatiqil akbari
fil ghaari mar-aa nazari wa maa ra-aw min arrimi
himal hafiizil maanihi yughnii hanil madaafihi
likulli habdin khashihi yatlubu khayral hurumi
